lesson.text: Quick memory: what do you say aloud to your grown-up at home? (Your address and their phone number.) Today: if you get lost.
Lost? Stop, and stay where you are. Your grown-up will come back to look for you there.
Ask a safe grown-up: someone who works there with a name badge, a mum or dad with children, or a police officer.
Never go anywhere with anyone, even if they say they'll help. A safe grown-up helps you right where you are.
A fire drill at school: leave your things, follow your teacher calmly to the meeting point and stay with your class.
Try it in the world: open the practice market and school. Next: the metro and the compass, on the Middle track.
